title: 第三千八百九十四章彻底释放超生命体第三千八百九十三章陨落的裂天神祇
content_zh:
听到身边竟有神祇敢质问自己，神祇族长不仅不恼，反而微微一笑道：“牺牲一个裂天，却能让我们整个神祇族得以升华，难道这不是一件好事情吗？”
“别忘了我们最终的目的是什么？难道你们这些年养老养糊涂了？只想着过上现在的日子，而对未来没有打算吗？若真是如此，我看诸位也没有存在的必要。”
此言一出，几位特殊神祇纷纷色变，即便是烛龙也不由面露惊恐，但很快他便恢复冷静道：“可是，即便如此，也没必要牺牲裂天了，他可是对族长大人您忠心耿耿，更是最早一批跟随在您身边的族人啊。”
“正是因为如此，才需要他的牺牲。”
“只有这样，才能让族人们知道，本族长为了能够带领大家成为超生命体，前往更广阔的宇宙，做出了怎样的选择。”
“放心吧，裂天神祇不会白白牺牲的，他会带着我们整个神祇族的意志，再次轮回重生，等到那时候他只会感谢本族长。”
“至于你们，也一样会明白我的良苦用心。”
“好了，马上就该轮到我们神祇族登场了，大家还是做好准备，不要让本族长失望才行。”
“嘿嘿嘿！！”
话音落下，神祇族长发出了极其阴冷的笑声。
而众多神祇闻言，纷纷不敢言语，只能默默在心里安慰自己。
哪怕是烛龙神祇，也只能无奈叹气，心里默念道：“再见了兄弟，希望族长大人真的不会辜负你的牺牲吧。”
“等到我们成为超生命体的那一天，我烛龙定会用尽一切办法找到你的转世之身！！！”
……
而当裂天神祇的气息消失在死灵渊中时，天子也看见了这极其恐怖的一幕，眼前的死灵渊正在被恐怖的能量所吞噬，甚至不断扩散，连死灵渊外也一样如此。
“不好！这股恐怖的能量，怕是要将我们全都吞噬干净！”
“快撤！！！”
天子话音落下，二话不说便朝着宇宙世界飞了过去。
他也不管身边那些主宰神盟的盟员听不听得懂。
天琊圣主见状，没有多问，而是感受到身后正有着一股恐怖的能量，在肆虐爆发时，连忙朝着天子的方向追了过去。

其余主宰神盟的盟员，也在这一刻感受到了莫大的危险，就在他们反应过来，都准备逃跑时，依旧有不少人被恐怖骇人的创世神力和神祇之力所吞噬消散。
甚至连任何声音都没有发出来，就悄无声息地被吞没。
死灵渊内，无数死灵同样消失在这股恐怖的能量之中，甚至连复活的机会都没有，因为五大死灵之神此刻也由于无法阻止光球的能量爆发，只能眼睁睁看见，他们守护了这么久的死灵渊，正一点点消失在眼前。
死灵老祖默默站在五大死灵之神旁边，神情无比悲凉，他微张嘴巴，似乎想要发出某种声音，但话到喉咙又咽了回去，只有无尽的苦笑在脸上挂着。
木吉尔等人手牵着手，看着身后即将被能量所淹没的封印之地时，神情从释怀到解脱，最后缓缓闭上了眼睛。
“结束了，原来不管我们如何镇守封印之地，都不过是神祇族长的一念之间，只要他想，随时都能释放出超生命体，真是可悲、可叹、可笑。”
“我们所存在的意义，难道就是为了成全神祇族长吗？”
“哎！！！”
死灵之龙古多娜道。
另外四大死灵之神都没有言语，只是默默等待身体的消散以及死灵渊的落幕。
这一刻已经没有什么好期待的，更没有什么好回忆的，也没有什么好后悔的。
毕竟他们做到了自己所能做到的一切，不负五大死灵之神之名……
很快，恐怖的永恒光芒和神祇之光将五人以及始魔老祖的身躯吞没，乃至整个禁区之地。
只见一根根蕴含着封印之力的镇魔柱，从死灵渊地底深处不断飞出，一根接着一根，数不胜数。
content_en:
Hearing that there was a god around him who dared to question him, the leader of the god clan was not only not annoyed, but smiled slightly and said: "Sacrificing a split sky can make our entire god clan sublime. Isn't this a good thing?"
"Don't forget what our ultimate goal is? Have you been confused by your retirement these years? Do you only think about living your life now and have no plans for the future? If this is the case, I think there is no need for you to exist."
As soon as these words came out, the expressions of several special gods changed. Even Zhulong could not help but look frightened, but he soon regained his composure and said: "But, even so, there is no need to sacrifice Split Sky. He is loyal to you, the patriarch, and he is one of the first tribesmen to follow you."
"That's why his sacrifice was needed."
"Only in this way can the clan members know what choices the clan leader has made in order to lead everyone to become super-life forms and go to a wider universe."
"Don't worry, God Splitter's sacrifice will not be in vain. He will be reincarnated again with the will of our entire God clan. When that time comes, he will only thank the leader of the clan."
"As for you, you will also understand my good intentions."
"Okay, it's our turn for the God Clan to appear soon. You'd better be prepared and don't disappoint the leader of the clan."
"Hey hey hey!!"
After the words fell, the god clan leader let out an extremely cold laugh.
When many gods heard this, they did not dare to speak, and could only comfort themselves silently in their hearts.
Even the Candle Dragon God could only sigh helplessly and said silently in his heart: "Goodbye brother, I hope the patriarch will really live up to your sacrifice."
"When the day comes that we become super life forms, I, Zhulong, will definitely use all means to find your reincarnation!!!"
…
And when the aura of the splitting gods disappeared into the Dead Soul Abyss, the Emperor also saw this extremely terrifying scene. The Dead Soul Abyss in front of him was being swallowed up by terrifying energy, and even continued to spread, even outside the Dead Soul Abyss.
"No! This terrifying energy may swallow us all up!"
"Quickly retreat!!!"
After the emperor finished speaking, he flew towards the universe without saying a word.
He didn't care whether the members of the Domineering God Alliance around him understood it or not.
When Holy Master Tianya saw this, he didn't ask any questions. Instead, he felt a terrifying energy behind him. When it exploded violently, he quickly chased in the direction of the emperor.
The other members of the Dominion God Alliance also felt the great danger at this moment. Just when they reacted and prepared to escape, many of them were still swallowed up and dissipated by the terrifying power of creation and gods.
It was swallowed up quietly without even making any sound.
In the Dead Soul Abyss, countless dead souls also disappeared into this terrifying energy, and there was no chance of resurrection. Because the five gods of the dead souls were unable to stop the energy explosion of the light ball at this moment, they could only watch helplessly as the Dead Soul Abyss, which they had guarded for so long, disappeared little by little before their eyes.
The ancestor of the undead stood silently next to the five gods of the undead, with an extremely sad expression. He opened his mouth slightly, as if he wanted to make some kind of sound, but when the words reached his throat, he swallowed them back, and only an endless bitter smile hung on his face.
Mujir and others held hands and looked at the sealed land behind them that was about to be flooded by energy. Their expressions changed from relief to relief, and finally they slowly closed their eyes.
"It's over. It turns out that no matter how we guard the sealed land, it's just a thought of the leader of the gods. As long as he wants to, he can release the super life forms at any time. It's really sad, deplorable, and ridiculous."
"Is the meaning of our existence just to fulfill the gods and patriarchs?"
"Hey!!!"
Gudona, the Dragon of the Undead, said.
The other four gods of the dead were silent and just waited silently.The dissipation of the body and the end of the Necromantic Abyss.
There is nothing to look forward to at this moment, nothing to remember, and nothing to regret.
After all, they did everything they could and lived up to the name of the Five Gods of the Dead...
Soon, the terrifying eternal light and the light of the gods engulfed the bodies of the five people and the ancestor of the First Demon, and even the entire restricted area.
I saw demon-suppressing pillars containing the power of seals, flying out from the depths of the Deadly Abyss, one after another, countless.
